subject: Data Engineering
title: Trust as a Data Product
description: A 60-second lesson on Trust as a Data Product.

hook.text: Analysts stop using the warehouse and build their own spreadsheets. Trust in the data is gone.

buildup.text: When data is unreliable, users create workarounds. Shadow spreadsheets multiply across the company.

discovery.text: Rebuilding trust requires consistent quality, transparent lineage, and fast incident response.

twist.text: Trust takes months to build and one bad incident to destroy. Quality must be a continuous practice.

climax.text: Treating data as a product means measuring user satisfaction, not just pipeline uptime.

punchline.text: Data nobody trusts is data nobody uses.

quiz.question: What happens when users lose trust in centralized data?
options: They create their own shadow spreadsheets
They ask for more data engineers
